scope: Make DRW_GeoPositionMarker DWG encoding transactional across parent and embedded-MTEXT body, string and handle streams; prove allocation-failure rollback and same-object retry.

changes: Run common entity fields, marker body, notes, embedded-MTEXT payload, parent entity handle and appended embedded handles inside encodeEntityDwgTransaction.
Preserve the existing version gate, field ordering, embedded-handle order, and alias-aware stream behavior.
implementation.failureBehavior: Injected allocation failure preserves caller stream bytes and bit positions and restores oType; retrying the same object with the same buffers reproduces clean output.

validation.allocationSweep: PASS: 3,614 allocation offsets across HATCH, MPOLYGON, MLEADER, ARCALIGNEDTEXT, LIGHT, SECTIONOBJECT, and GEOPOSITIONMARKER; 155 entity/version/stream-layout profiles

coverage: Generated AC1027 unframed and AC1032 framed marker profiles use five body/string/handle alias layouts each.
The AC1032 profile includes embedded MTEXT with detached note text and appended embedded handle data.
Each injected allocation failure checks stream rollback and oType restoration, then retries the same object into the same seeded buffers and compares exact output with clean encoding.
limitations: This proves generated transaction/failure behavior only, not GEOPOSITIONMARKER wire semantics, native rendering, physical-source behavior, or graph/output qualification.
No DWG or DXF drawing fixture was added.
